SECRET AND PERSONAL.

37a

American Embassy,
71, Grosvenor Street, W.1.

Dr. Fritz EBERHARD formerly RAUSCHENPLAT.

Referring to your letter No. 1584 of 12th January 1950, and the attached form.

EBERHARD has not come to our adverse notice since our previous correspondence.

A. Knowles.

L158/1424/C.1.a./AK.
